plugins.name: perfectlittlebusiness
plugins.description: The Perfect Little Business plugin. Your AI Operating System (AIOS), set up step by step with your plan from Perfect Little Business HQ already in it, and your way into HQ from Claude, Claude Code or Codex. Run your planning steps here (Your Business Today, Avatar Emotional Profile, Offer Architect, Conviction Map, What Makes You Different, Brand Style Guide, Your Story, Goals and Vision, Your Sales Path, Marketing Plan) and each one saves to your business plan in HQ and to your brain/ folder. /source-of-truth pulls your whole plan into one document, /start loads your plan and this week's content calendar, /draft-social marks drafts on that calendar, and the operating skills keep the system self-improving: /hq to see where your plan stands and run any step or guide, /start and /end for every session, /learn and /decide to capture what you discover, /hold for ideas worth keeping, /hygiene to keep it healthy, and /how-to for anything else.
